purpose: Shared SHRESTA service-unavailable state for SSR pages whose SHRESTA service dependency cannot be reached or returns a not-found service response.
businessRules: Use this only for SHRESTA service reachability failures and service 404 responses, not for frontend routes that do not exist.
Storefront surfaces use the full-page frame; admin surfaces use the panel frame inside the admin layout.
Customer-facing copy must not mention backend, API, route, port, database, metadata, contract, storage, framework, or runtime details.
